faqs.question: What is Azure CDN?
faqs.answer: Azure CDN is a global content delivery network solution that accelerates the delivery of high-bandwidth content to users by caching content at strategically placed physical nodes across the world.

faqs.question: How does Azure CDN improve website performance?
faqs.answer: By caching content closer to users at edge servers, Azure CDN reduces latency and load times, resulting in faster and more reliable access to web content.

faqs.question: Can Azure CDN handle dynamic content?
faqs.answer: Yes, Azure CDN supports dynamic site acceleration, optimizing the delivery of dynamic, non-cacheable content through various network optimizations.
